title: Defrost Active
shortDescription: Heat pump in normal defrost cycle.
fullDescription: ICP-family (Comfortmaker, Heil, Tempstar all share boards) signal 1F when reversing valve shifted to defrost mode. Cycle ends in 5-10 min.

fixSteps.title: Wait
fixSteps.instruction: Defrost ends when coil sensor reaches termination temp.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: High Pressure Trip
fullDescription: Outdoor coil overpressured during cooling - dirty coil or failed condenser fan.

fixSteps.title: Wash coil
fixSteps.instruction: Garden hose, fins from inside out.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Low Pressure Trip
fullDescription: Suction pressure below cutout - charge loss, low ambient, or restriction.
whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Reversing Valve Fault
fullDescription: Board commands cooling but suction line stays warm (or vice versa). Faulty solenoid or stuck valve.
symptoms: Wrong air temp for selected mode

fixSteps.title: Test solenoid
fixSteps.instruction: Ohm reversing valve coil; ~10-30 ohms typical.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Outdoor Coil Sensor Fault
fullDescription: Defrost relies on coil sensor to start/stop. Open or shorted sensor causes excessive defrost or icing.

fixSteps.title: Inspect sensor wire
fixSteps.instruction: Check for chafing where wire enters cabinet.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Ambient Sensor Fault
fullDescription: Ambient sensor drives staging and aux lockout. Fault forces conservative aux usage.

fixSteps.title: Replace ambient sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Sensor mounts behind louver near top of cabinet.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Compressor Cycle Lockout
fullDescription: After 3 nuisance trips within an hour, board locks compressor for 4 hours.

fixSteps.title: Cycle 24V power
fixSteps.instruction: Drop and restore thermostat call to clear lockout after fixing root cause.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Inducer Fault (paired air handler)
shortDescription: Inducer/blower communication fault between heat pump and air handler.
fullDescription: On Observer communicating systems, 8F flags loss of data from indoor blower or gas furnace inducer.

fixSteps.title: Inspect ABCD wires
fixSteps.instruction: Check at both ends for tightness.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Compressor Drive Fault
shortDescription: Inverter compressor drive reported internal fault.
fullDescription: On 2-stage and variable models, inverter board protects against overcurrent, overtemp, or DC bus errors.

fixSteps.title: Clean cabinet
fixSteps.instruction: Vacuum debris around inverter heat sink.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: No Fault
shortDescription: Status indicator showing no current faults.
fullDescription: 0F or steady green LED means board self-test passed. Useful as confirmation when troubleshooting communication issues.
whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.
